name: Horizon CTA
description: A closing call to action where light rises over a horizon in ordered Bayer dither: silver by default, one accent prop recolours it, copy staggers in above.

props.name: muted
props.description: Substring of the headline set at 45% white; it lands a beat after the rest.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono label above the headline, between two hairlines that draw outward.

props.name: primary
props.description: White primary button. Hover is calm: the surface dims a touch and the arrow nudges 2px; nothing glows, lifts or grows.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Dark glass secondary button that stays legible over the light.

props.name: notes
props.description: Three reassurance notes along the bottom.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour of the light. The dither ramps panel → accent → a pale core; pass a brand hue to recolour the whole horizon.

props.name: cell
props.description: Dither cell size in CSS px. 3 reads as texture, 5 as pixel art.

props.name: lean
props.description: How far the light leans toward a mouse pointer, as a fraction of the panel width. 0 keeps the sun centred.

controls.label: Headline
controls.default: Ship the version you’d be proud to demo.
